label: Dyslipidaemia (disorders of lipoprotein metabolism)
description: Two diagnosis codes, or one code plus lipid-lowering therapy, within two years; children roll up regardless
source: project rule (two-code / code plus treatment pattern)

label: High LDL-C
description: LDL-C >= 160 mg/dL (4.14 mmol/L) at any measurement, or coded pure hypercholesterolaemia
source: NCEP ATP III (NIH Publication 01-3670, 2001), Table 2

label: Severe hypercholesterolaemia
description: Highest LDL-C >= 190 mg/dL (4.91 mmol/L)
source: NCEP ATP III Table 2 (very high); 2018 AHA/ACC guideline (LDL-C >= 190 mg/dL, DOI 10.1161/CIR.0000000000000625)

label: DLCN LDL-C criterion: possible FH range (LDL-C 5.0-8.5 mmol/L, 3 or 5 points)
description: Highest LDL-C >= 5.0 mmol/L; LDL-C points alone put the DLCN score in the possible FH band (3-5)
source: Dutch Lipid Clinic Network criteria, as tabulated in CADTH Lomitapide review 2015 (NCBI Bookshelf NBK362539, Table 10) and ESC/EAS 2019

label: DLCN LDL-C criterion: probable FH (LDL-C > 8.5 mmol/L, 8 points)
description: Highest LDL-C > 8.5 mmol/L; 8 points put the DLCN score in the probable FH band (6-8) on LDL-C alone
source: Dutch Lipid Clinic Network criteria, as tabulated in CADTH Lomitapide review 2015 (NCBI Bookshelf NBK362539, Table 10) and ESC/EAS 2019

label: Low HDL-C (sex-specific)
description: Most recent HDL-C < 40 mg/dL (1.03 mmol/L) in men, < 50 mg/dL (1.29 mmol/L) in women, or coded lipoprotein deficiency
source: NCEP ATP III Table 8 (metabolic syndrome HDL cutoffs)

label: High triglycerides
description: Highest TG >= 200 mg/dL (2.26 mmol/L), or coded hyperglyceridaemia
source: NCEP ATP III (NIH Publication 01-3670, 2001), triglyceride classification

label: Very high triglycerides
description: Highest TG >= 500 mg/dL (5.65 mmol/L)
source: NCEP ATP III (NIH Publication 01-3670, 2001), triglyceride classification

label: Mixed hyperlipidaemia (coded)
description: Diagnosis code for mixed hyperlipidaemia
source: WHO ICD-10 E78.2

label: High total cholesterol
description: Total cholesterol >= 240 mg/dL (6.21 mmol/L)
source: NCEP ATP III (NIH Publication 01-3670, 2001), Table 2

label: Elevated Lp(a)
description: Lp(a) > 50 mg/dL or > 105 nmol/L
source: 2025 Focused Update of the 2019 ESC/EAS dyslipidaemia guidelines (Eur Heart J 46(42):4359), as summarised by PACE-CME

label: Very high Lp(a)
description: Lp(a) > 180 mg/dL or > 430 nmol/L (not observable in UKB field 30790, whose reported maximum is 189 nmol/L)
source: 2019 ESC/EAS dyslipidaemia guidelines (Eur Heart J 41(1):111, DOI 10.1093/eurheartj/ehz455)

label: Elevated apolipoprotein B
description: ApoB >= 130 mg/dL (1.30 g/L), a risk-enhancing factor
source: 2018 AHA/ACC guideline risk-enhancing factors (Family Heart Foundation summary)

label: Lipid-lowering therapy
description: At least two prescriptions of a lipid-regulating drug, or self-reported cholesterol-lowering medication
source: WHO ATC C10; BNF section 2.12; UKB fields 6177/6153

label: Type 2 diabetes
description: Coded type 2 diabetes; children roll up
source: WHO ICD-10 E11; ClinicalCodes.org; OpenSAFELY diabetes codelist

label: T2D with renal complications
description: Coded renal complication of type 2 diabetes
source: WHO ICD-10 E11.2; ClinicalCodes.org; OpenSAFELY diabetes codelist

label: T2D with ophthalmic complications
description: Coded ophthalmic complication of type 2 diabetes
source: WHO ICD-10 E11.3; ClinicalCodes.org; OpenSAFELY diabetes codelist

label: T2D with poor glycaemic control
description: Coded poor control, or most recent HbA1c >= 75 mmol/mol (9.0%)
source: NICE NG28 recommendation 1.7.26 (HbA1c 75 mmol/mol threshold)

label: Hypertension
description: Coded hypertension; children roll up
source: WHO ICD-10 I10-I15; ClinicalCodes.org; OpenSAFELY hypertension codelist

label: Essential hypertension
description: Coded essential hypertension
source: WHO ICD-10 I10

label: Secondary hypertension
description: Coded secondary hypertension
source: WHO ICD-10 I15

label: Hypertensive heart or kidney disease
description: Coded hypertensive heart and/or renal disease
source: WHO ICD-10 I11-I13

label: Blood pressure medication (self-reported)
description: UKB touchscreen answer 'Blood pressure medication'
source: UKB Showcase fields 6177/6153, data-coding 100625

label: Asthma
description: Coded asthma; children roll up
source: WHO ICD-10 J45-J46; ClinicalCodes.org; OpenSAFELY asthma codelist

label: Allergic asthma
description: Coded predominantly allergic / extrinsic asthma
source: WHO ICD-10 J45.0

label: Non-allergic asthma
description: Coded non-allergic / intrinsic asthma
source: WHO ICD-10 J45.1

label: Severe or acute asthma
description: Coded status asthmaticus / acute exacerbation / brittle asthma
source: WHO ICD-10 J46; ClinicalCodes.org
